text:
Di Federal High Court for Abuja , Nigeria capital don sack di Senator David Mark-led executives of di African Democratic Congress (ADC) and cancel all actions dem take on behalf of di party.
Justice Peter Lifu give di judgement on Thursday, 5 November.
Di actions wey e cancel include di primary election wey di party hold for May dis year, wey produce former Vice President Abubakar Atiku as dia presidential candidate for di 2027 general elections.
Dis judgement na sake of di mata wey former Deputy National chairman of di ADC, Nafiu Bala Gombe, bin carry go court to complain say na im suppose be di national chairman of di party, no be David Mark.
Gombe argue say since di former ADC national Chairman Ralph Nwosu resign from im office, voluntarily, di party constitution tok say na di deputy suppose bicom di acting chairman.
E also argue say di way David Mark and Rauf Aregbesola take emerge as di new national chairman and secretary of di ADC respectively, dey against di party constitution.
Gombe ask di court to stop di two individuals - David Mark and Rauf Aregbesola - from parading diasef as di national chairman and national secretary of di ADC.
Also, Gombe ask di court to declare say all di actions wey di purported ADC exco bin carry out starting from 27 July 2025 wen dem come into office reach now, dey null and void.
For im judgement, Justice Lifu agree wit evritin wey oga Nafiu Bala Gombe tok and also grant evritin wey e ask di court.
"All di actions taken by di ADC as a party since July 27 to date stand annulled," Lukman Fagbemi (SAN), wey represent Nafiu Bala Gombe for court, tell tori pipo afta di judgement on Thursday.
